title: Leader answer — common envelope (stage 2, scope §2.0, §2.3, §2.4)
description: The answer of a needs_leader call without situation fields: blocked, output-format-twice, session-limit, on-fail-exceeded, soft-budget. Every other leader-answer schema is this envelope plus its situation fields. ENUM TEMPLATE: values like "{answers}" are placeholders that schema.fill_enums replaces for each call (codes.LEADER_SCHEMA_TOKENS); an id list that comes out empty drops its property (read as []). Keeps to type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum (the CLI's structured-output subset). Rules a schema cannot say (rerun ⇔ step, escalate ⇔ recommendation, coverage of every id, the situation rules) are checked by gxengine/leader.py (codes.LeaderFormatReason).

answer.description: One of the answers the engine allows for this call (rendered per call). The engine acts on this field only.

reason.description: Leader-decision reason code (§4.2, scope D20). Pick `other` only when no code fits.

step.description: The step to run again — set exactly when answer is rerun, otherwise null.

note.description: Free text for the next role (leader-decision.md), the human and evolve. The engine never branches on it.

recommendation.description: Set exactly when answer is escalate: what you recommend the human answers (scope D15). Otherwise null.

step.description: Set exactly when the recommended answer is rerun.
